subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: What do Filter Methods avoid using to evaluate the final feature subset?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي لا تستخدمه طرائق الترشيح لتقييم مجموعة الخصائص النهائية؟
questions.explanation: Filter methods select features based on their statistical characteristics, without using a data mining algorithm to evaluate the final feature subset.

questions.question: Which datasets are Filter Methods usually suitable for?
questions.question_ar: لأي مجموعات بيانات تلائم طرائق الترشيح عادة؟
questions.explanation: They are usually fast and suitable for datasets with many features.

questions.question: What does correlation measure?
options: The feature and the target are associated.
options_en: The feature and the target are associated.
questions.explanation: Correlation measures the relationship between two variables.

questions.question: Which relationship type is especially captured by correlation?
questions.question_ar: أي نوع من العلاقات يلتقطه الارتباط على نحو خاص؟
questions.explanation: Important: Low correlation does not always mean that a feature is useless because correlation mainly captures certain types of relationships, especially linear relationships.

questions.question: Which correlation measure is most commonly used?
questions.question_ar: أي مقياس للارتباط هو الأكثر استخداماً؟
questions.explanation: The most commonly used measure is Pearson correlation coefficient, denoted by .

questions.question: Which feature and target types are related by the Chi-square test?
questions.question_ar: ما نوعا الخاصية والهدف اللذان يربط بينهما اختبار كاي-تربيع؟
options: The feature and the target are independent.
The feature and the target are associated.
categorical features and a categorical target
options_en: The feature and the target are independent.
The feature and the target are associated.
categorical features and a categorical target
questions.explanation: The Chi-square test measures the relationship between categorical features and a categorical target.

questions.question: What are observed frequencies?
options: the information shared by a feature and target
what we actually see in the dataset
a feature subset and model performance
options_en: the information shared by a feature and target
what we actually see in the dataset
a feature subset and model performance
options_ar: ما نراه فعلياً في مجموعة البيانات
questions.explanation: Observed frequencies → what we actually see in the dataset.
questions.explanation_ar: ما نراه فعلياً في مجموعة البيانات

questions.question: What do expected frequencies represent in the independence test?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تمثل التكرارات المتوقعة في اختبار الاستقلال؟
options: The feature has no relationship of any kind with another variable.
Which combination of features produces the best model performance?
what we would expect if Smoking Status and Heart Disease were independent
the amount of information shared between a feature and the target
options_en: The feature has no relationship of any kind with another variable.
Which combination of features produces the best model performance?
what we would expect if Smoking Status and Heart Disease were independent
the amount of information shared between a feature and the target
options_ar: لا توجد للخاصية أي علاقة من أي نوع بمتغير آخر.
أي مجموعة من الخصائص تحقق أفضل أداء للنموذج؟
ما نتوقعه لو كان التدخين ومرض القلب مستقلين
كمية المعلومات المشتركة بين الخاصية والهدف
questions.explanation: Expected frequencies → what we would expect if Smoking Status and Heart Disease were independent.
questions.explanation_ar: ما نتوقعه لو كان التدخين ومرض القلب مستقلين

questions.question: What does the null hypothesis state in the Chi-square test?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تنص الفرضية الصفرية في اختبار كاي-تربيع؟
options: The feature and the target are independent.
categorical features and a categorical target
The feature and the target are associated.
The feature completely determines the target.
options_en: The feature and the target are independent.
categorical features and a categorical target
The feature and the target are associated.
The feature completely determines the target.
questions.explanation: The feature and the target are independent.

questions.question: What does the alternative hypothesis state?
options: The feature and the target are associated.
The feature completely determines the target.
The feature and the target are independent.
options_en: The feature and the target are associated.
The feature completely determines the target.
The feature and the target are independent.
questions.explanation: The feature and the target are associated.

questions.question: What is often more convenient to examine in Chi-square feature selection?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يكون فحصه أكثر ملاءمة غالباً في اختيار الخصائص بكاي-تربيع؟
options: is selected only after model training
more convenient to look at the p-value
more convenient to look at the variance threshold
options_en: is selected only after model training
more convenient to look at the p-value
more convenient to look at the variance threshold
options_ar: النظر إلى قيمة p أكثر ملاءمة
النظر إلى عتبة التباين أكثر ملاءمة
questions.explanation: However, when using Chi-Square for feature selection, it is often more convenient to look at the p-value.
questions.explanation_ar: النظر إلى قيمة p أكثر ملاءمة

questions.question: What does Information Gain measure?
options: how much a feature affects prediction performance in a forest
how much information a feature provides about the target
more convenient to look at the number of selected features
how frequently an itemset occurs in transactions
options_en: how much a feature affects prediction performance in a forest
how much information a feature provides about the target
more convenient to look at the number of selected features
how frequently an itemset occurs in transactions
options_ar: مقدار تأثير الخاصية في أداء التنبؤ داخل غابة
مقدار المعلومات التي توفرها خاصية عن الهدف
النظر إلى عدد الخصائص المختارة أكثر ملاءمة
مدى تكرار مجموعة عناصر في المعاملات
questions.explanation: Information Gain measures how much information a feature provides about the target.
questions.explanation_ar: مقدار المعلومات التي توفرها خاصية عن الهدف

questions.question: What target effect indicates high Information Gain?
questions.question_ar: ما الأثر في الهدف الذي يدل على كسب معلومات مرتفع؟
options: has almost the same value for every observation
is selected only after model training
options_en: has almost the same value for every observation
is selected only after model training
options_ar: يمتلك قيمة متقاربة في كل مشاهدة
questions.explanation: A feature that significantly reduces uncertainty about the target has high information gain.

questions.question: What relationship can Mutual Information capture that simple correlation may miss?
questions.question_ar: ما نوع العلاقة التي قد يلتقطها الترابط المتبادل ولا يلتقطها الارتباط البسيط؟
questions.explanation: It can capture nonlinear relationships, which makes it different from simple correlation.

questions.question: Which features does Variance Threshold remove?
options: features selected by a random forest
options_en: features selected by a random forest
questions.explanation: A near-constant attribute carries almost no information, so it cannot separate classes.

questions.question: What does the Pearson coefficient measure?
options: the strength of a linear relation
the strength of any kind of relation
the number of shared attribute values
the order of the recorded categories
options_en: the strength of a linear relation
the strength of any kind of relation
the number of shared attribute values
the order of the recorded categories
questions.explanation: Pearson captures how closely two variables follow a straight-line relationship.
questions.explanation_ar: بيرسون يقيس مدى قرب متغيرين من علاقة خطية مستقيمة.

questions.question: What does the Chi-square test compare?
options: the means of two numeric samples
the ranks of the paired values
options_en: the means of two numeric samples
the ranks of the paired values
questions.explanation: It compares the counts actually seen with the counts expected if the two variables were independent.
questions.explanation_ar: يقارن التكرارات المرصودة فعلاً بما يُتوقع لو كان المتغيران مستقلين.

questions.question: How are degrees of freedom found for a contingency table?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُحدد درجات الحرية لجدول تقاطعي؟
questions.explanation: Degrees of freedom come from the number of rows and columns of the table.
questions.explanation_ar: درجات الحرية تُشتق من عدد صفوف الجدول وأعمدته.

questions.question: Which feature does Information Gain favour?
options: the one with most missing values
the one with the largest range
the one used least in the data
options_en: the one with most missing values
the one with the largest range
the one used least in the data
questions.explanation: Information gain prefers the feature that removes the most uncertainty about the class.
questions.explanation_ar: كسب المعلومات يفضّل السمة التي تزيل أكبر قدر من عدم اليقين حول الصنف.
